newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arafat to meet EU foreign ministers on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to meet EU foreign ministers on Tuesday.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat will meet European Union foreign ministers on Tuesday evening in Brussels along with Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy, according to a statement issued by the Luxembourg EU presidency.
"A discussion is also foreseen with the president of the Palestine authority Mr Yasser Arafat," the statement said.

An official from the Luxembourg presidency was unable to say whether Arafat would meet Levy directly. The Israeli minister arrives in Brussels late on Sunday for the meeting with EU foreign ministers.

Both men will meet the ministers at the invitation of the Luxembourg EU presidency. The EU has been trying to broker talks between these two key players in the Middle East peace process, which has been stalled for the past four months.
EU ministers will be briefed on the situation in the Middle East by the 15-nation grouping's special envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos.
A spokesman for Arafat told Reuters in Gaza earlier on Monday that the Palestinian leader would fly to Brussels on Monday, but that it was not yet clear whether he would meet Levy.
